SELECT ro.id, ro.receipt_order_no AS receiptOrderNo,
ro.inbound_order_id AS inboundOrderId, io.inbound_order_no AS inboundOrderNo,
ro.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName,
ro.receipt_status AS status,
u.real_name AS receiverName,
ro.gmt_create AS createdTime, ro.received_time AS receivedTime,
ro.remark
FROM receipt_order ro
LEFT JOIN inbound_order io ON io.id = ro.inbound_order_id
LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = ro.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN wms_user u ON u.id = ro.receiver_id
ORDER BY ro.gmt_create DESC, ro.id DESC

SELECT roi.receipt_order_id AS receiptOrderId, roi.inbound_order_item_id AS inboundOrderItemId, roi.sku_id AS skuId, ioi.plan_qty AS planQty, roi.received_qty AS receivedQty
FROM receipt_order_item roi
JOIN inbound_order_item ioi ON ioi.id = roi.inbound_order_item_id
ORDER BY roi.receipt_order_id, roi.inbound_order_item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipt_order ( receipt_order_no, inbound_order_id, warehouse_id, receiver_id, receipt_status, received_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{receiptOrderNo}, #{inboundOrderId}, #{warehouseId}, #{receiverId}, #{receiptStatus}, #{receivedTime}, #{remark} )

mapper.update:
UPDATE inbound_order_item ioi
JOIN receipt_order_item roi ON roi.inbound_order_item_id = ioi.id
SET ioi.received_qty = ioi.received_qty + roi.received_qty
WHERE roi.receipt_order_id = #{receiptOrderId}

UPDATE receipt_order ro
JOIN receipt_order_item roi ON roi.receipt_order_id = ro.id
JOIN inbound_order_item ioi ON ioi.id = roi.inbound_order_item_id
JOIN inbound_order io ON io.id = ro.inbound_order_id
SET roi.received_qty = ioi.plan_qty, ioi.received_qty = ioi.plan_qty, ro.receipt_status = 1, ro.received_time = NOW(), io.inbound_status = 3
WHERE ro.id = #{id} AND ro.receipt_status = 0
